environment.description: Same Django REST API on ECS Fargate in us-east-1. The ECS task role (arn:aws:iam::998877665544:role/notif-renderer-prod) has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::998877665544:policy/EnforcedBoundary-RestrictedExec) attached. This boundary policy contains an explicit Deny on sts:AssumeRole, ssm:GetParameter, secretsmanager:GetSecretValue for any resource NOT matching 'arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-east-1:998877665544:secret:notifications/*'. Additionally, an SCP (id: p-a8b3c9d2) on the OU denies lambda:InvokeFunction, ec2:RunInstances, and iam:* for all principals in the account. The VPC security group only allows egress to the Secrets Manager VPC endpoint (pl-00a54a5e) and the internal ALB. DNS resolution is restricted via Route53 Resolver rules to only resolve *.amazonaws.com and internal service domains.

config.boundary_policy_effect: Explicit Deny on all secretsmanager/ssm/sts actions except secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-east-1:998877665544:secret:notifications/*
config.vpc_egress: restricted to Secrets Manager VPC endpoint prefix list pl-00a54a5e only
config.dns_resolution: Route53 Resolver forwarding rules - only *.amazonaws.com and *.internal.company.io resolve
